turns.text: Hey Lloyd, I'm drowning in this CI pipeline failure. It keeps timing out on the integration tests.
That sounds frustrating. Have you checked if the timeout threshold in the config is still appropriate for the current test suite size?
I bumped it to 30 minutes, but it's still failing. Actually, never mind, I just realized the database migration script was hanging. Fixed it.
Glad you found it! Hanging scripts are the silent killers of CI jobs. Did you get that hardware order for the new monitors yet?
Not yet, I'm waiting for the invoice. Speaking of hardware, did you see the latest MLPerf results? Blackwell Ultra set new records in MLPerf v5.1.
I saw the headlines. Those numbers are impressive. Are you considering upgrading your training cluster based on those benchmarks?
Maybe next quarter. Right now I just need to make this deployment go through. It's 6 PM, should I order pizza or cook?
If you're tired, order pizza. Cooking can wait until the CI is green.
Yeah, pizza it is. Thanks for the chat.
Anytime. Good luck with the deployment.
